title: Partner fulfil, version 1
description: Extension point fulfil: what iVendNext POS sends a partner's HTTPS service to make a code (a voucher, a PIN) for a PAID sale line an item filter names (issue_request), and to cancel it before that line is refunded or when the sale is cancelled (void_request), and what the service answers. Answers are judged by business_logic/partner_fulfil.py validate_answer: one bad key or value refuses the whole answer, which then reads as no answer (the receipt keeps waiting; a cancel changes nothing). The key rule: the same idempotency_key always returns the same code, and a void on a key wins over any later issue on it. iVendNext holds no lock across the call; it writes an answer only while the line is still waiting, and cancels at once a code that arrives for a line already settled.

settings.description: The subscription's settings field (a JSON object, stored as text on the Retail Extension Subscription of extension point fulfil): the items the service makes a code for — item groups (and below), an Item field that is set, or both. The scan capture's filter.

issue_context.description: Sent after the sale's booking commits, once per line, and again on a retry (1 and 5 minutes, or the cashier's Try again) with the SAME idempotency_key. face_minor is the line's list price (its rate where there is none) in the sale's currency — the voucher's value; amount_minor is what the line was sold for, the same field and meaning as check/1's. No card data, serial, batch or other line.

void_context.description: Sent before a return of the line is booked (the till's return screen or the Desk's Cancel code), when the sale is cancelled, and at once for a code that arrived for a line already settled. ref is the code to cancel; empty while the code is still on its way — cancel whatever the key holds, and never issue on it after.

issue_answer.description: HTTP 2xx, a JSON object of at most 64 KB. issued: ref is your own id of the code (1-80 plain characters); lines print under the item (1-6 lines of at most 48 plain characters). refuse: the receipt prints that the code could not be issued and the cashier refunds the line. No amount, price, quantity or other key.

void_answer.description: HTTP 2xx, a JSON object of at most 64 KB. voided: the code is cancelled (and stays so: a later issue on the key is refused). refuse: the code stays (it was used, say), so the line cannot be refunded; the sentence is shown to the cashier.
